scheme2_name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana - Short Term Training (PMKVY)

comparisons.scheme1_value: Gives cash money (Rs. 6,000/year) directly to farmers' bank accounts to help buy seeds, fertilizer, and daily needs.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Teaches job skills (like welding, computer repair, beauty care) to young people and helps them find jobs.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Farmers who own land in their own name. Excluded: government employees, pensioners earning Rs. 10,000+/month, doctors/engineers/lawyers, income-tax payers, politicians.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Young Indians aged 15-45 who dropped out of school/college or are unemployed. Must have Aadhaar card.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Rs. 6,000 per year in 3 payments of Rs. 2,000 every 4 months. Goes straight to your bank account (no middlemen).
comparisons.scheme2_value: Free skill training + soft skills + financial literacy + job placement help. Also travel cost, accident insurance, and placement bonus for certified candidates.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Aadhaar Card, land ownership papers, bank account details (must be Aadhaar-linked).
comparisons.scheme2_value: Mainly Aadhaar card (mandatory). Other documents depend on the job skill you choose.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Online at pmkisan.gov.in: Register with Aadhaar number, verify OTP, upload documents. Can also apply at CSCs (Common Service Centers).
comparisons.scheme2_value: Offline: Visit nearest training centre (find at pmkvyofficial.org/trainingcenter) OR register online at skillindiadigital.gov.in.

comparisons.scheme1_value: No fixed deadline — registration stays open year-round. Installments released every 4 months.
comparisons.scheme2_value: No fixed deadline — training batches run throughout the year. Contact your nearest centre for next batch start date.

comparisons.scheme1_value: If any family member paid Income Tax last year, the entire family becomes ineligible — even if they own farmland.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Aadhaar card is mandatory at enrolment. You must attend at least 70% of classes to take the final exam.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Land must be in your own name. You cannot qualify by farming someone else's land.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Some advanced courses (NSQF Level 5+) may charge fees, but poor/weak students still get free support.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Your bank account must be linked to Aadhaar, otherwise the money won't reach you.
comparisons.scheme2_value: No major rule stated. Training is free, placement help is provided.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
comparisons.scheme2_value: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

recommendation: **These schemes help different people:** PM-KISAN is for farmers with land (gives money). PMKVY is for young people without jobs (teaches skills). **Pick PM-KISAN if:** you own farmland and need cash for farming. **Pick PMKVY if:** you're 15-45 years old, want to learn a job skill, and need help finding work. **You can use BOTH if you qualify for both** — there's no rule against it. **⚠️ Disclaimer:** This is AI guidance based on official information. For final decisions, check the official websites (pmkisan.gov.in or skillindiadigital.gov.in) or contact the helplines. This is not legal or official advice.
